title: Goldreich–Levin candidates
statement: For a natural number $n$, a coordinate $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and a finite family $\mathcal A$ of sets of coordinates, the candidate family is the union, over $S\in\mathcal A$, of the two children $S$ and $S\cup\{i\}$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is a coordinate among the first $n$ coordinates
$\mathcal A$ is a finite family of sets of those coordinates
